text:
Anya: quick thread 1: prototyping a compact rollout metadata extension: per-variant `stability_hint` (low|medium|high) + optional `cost_profile` (low|medium|high) so routing can prefer cheaper variants when latency slack exists.
Kevin: sketch the shape? backward compat and pins are my main worry.
Maria: absolutely also we must ensure tenant/route pins can never be silently bypassed by cost routing.
Anya: sketch (informational):
```
rollout_schema_version: 1
enforcement: false
variants: [
  id: "v1-quant", stability_hint: "high", cost_profile: "low", signal_sources: ["eval-a","prod-regressions"]
  id: "v2-fp16", stability_hint: "medium", cost_profile: "medium"
]
fallback_policy: "strict"
```
Samira: define stability_hint semantics: ops signal vs regression probability?
Anya: ops signal derived from eval+prod windows. high = stable 30d+, medium = intermittent regressions under adversarial prompts, low = experimental or <7d of data.
Josh: who publishes the quality signal? research-prod?
Oliver: research will emit a daily `variant_quality` metric and `quality_window_days`. we'll provide a mapping to stability_hint and a changelog entry for variants.
Kevin: contract rules proposal: explicit client pin -> router must honor exactly. tenant/route pins > rollout hints. if no pin, router may use stability_hint+cost_profile+SLO to pick variant.
Maria: migration: older agents expect only `model_id`. new fields must be optional and ignored by older clients. add `rollout_schema_version`. unknown schema -> router fall back to pin-only safe path.
Anya: also add `allow_cost_routing` at tenant/deployment config so private deployments can opt out.
Samira: add `enforcement` boolean so model owners can lock behavior even without tenant pins. enforcement==true => router cannot deviate.
Josh: suggest tenant opt-in `experimental_routing` flag for early adopters; must include SLA guardrails and quick opt-out.
Kevin: telemetry requirement: any decision to route away from higher-stability variant must emit a `routing_decision` event with reason and score breakdown for auditing and regression triage.
Anya: example `routing_decision` (informational):
```
chosen_variant: "v1-quant"
considered: ["v2-fp16"]
reasons: ["cost_delta:0.6","latency_ok"]
score_breakdown: ["stability:0.8","cost:0.4"]
policy_version: "rollout_metadata_v1"
```
Maria: console should flag when routing is allowed to diverge, list active pins/overrides, and surface tenant opt-ins.
Samira: variants should include `signal_sources` and `last_evaluated_ts` so we can trace where hints came from.
Oliver: research will deliver thresholds and a baseline variant list for ops to sanity-check before enabling cost routing.
Kevin: validation: router reads `rollout_schema_version` int; if schema > supported -> fail-safe to pin-only routing and emit warning.
Anya: plan: v1 behind feature flag `rollout_metadata_v1` in launchpad. implement scoring in router but default to stability-first unless tenant opted into cost routing. two-week dogfood timeline for internal testing.
Josh: include migration checklist in the RFC follow-up PR: schema field, onboarding scripts, control-plane validation, console flags, router fallback, telemetry hooks, and example interactions with pinned leases and dedicated pools + canary semantics.
Anya: i'll open the RFC follow-up PR with JSON Schema, validation tests, examples, and checklist. tagging kevin/maria/oliver for review. will post the PR link when ready.
Deploy-bot: reminder: add feature flag key `rollout_metadata_v1` to launchpad if this lands.
Anya: filing PR now. :thumbsup:
